PIL: Beijing Control, CSN2132, WXI 35, 9500m, estimating HG 50, next VYK.
CTL: CSN2132, decelerate en route due traffic separation.
Q: What did the controller instruct the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，南航2132，WXI 35分，9500米，预计HG 50分，下个报告点VYK。
管：南航2132，由于间隔巡航中减速。
问：管制员指挥飞行员怎样做？
choices: Keep enough space from traffic ahead
Keep high speed due to spacing
choicesZh: 与前方活动保持足够空间
由于间隔当前位置等待
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Keep enough space from traffic ahead

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CCA102, how long is the delay going to be?
CTL: CCA102, expect 2 minutes. We have a vehicle conducting a visual inspection of the runway.
Q: Which of the following is the cause of delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：地面，国航102，延误预计有多久？
管：国航102，预计延误2分钟，有车辆正对跑道进行目视检查。
问：以下哪项是延误的原因？
choices: An aircraft is passing across the runway
A vehicle has broken down on the runway
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The runway is under inspection

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA101, engine failure, request tow back to parking bay, and passengers need to transfer to another plane.
CTL: CCA101, roger, tow back to Gate 302.
Q: Which of the following did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航101，发动机失效，请求拖回停机位，乘客需要被转移到另一架飞机。
管：国航101，收到，拖回302机位。
问：飞行员请求的是以下哪项？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Transfer of passengers

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, use caution, taxi slowly to your Gate, there is no marshaller on duty.
PIL: Roger, thanks, CCA121.
Q: According to the statement, which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，注意，缓慢滑行到停机位，无进位引导。
飞：收到，谢谢，国航121。
问：根据陈述，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: The Gate is too narrow for the aircraft
There is nobody to guide the aircraft to the Gate
The marshaller is in the aircraft’s path
choicesZh: 无人引导飞机滑到机位
进位引导在飞机的进位轨迹
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is nobody to guide the aircraft to the Gate

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, Beijing Control, descend to 8900m, report reaching, radar shadow about 50 miles ahead.
PIL: Roger, descend to 8900m, report reaching, CCA121.
Q: According to the information, which of the following is correct for CCA121?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，北京区调，下降到8900米，到达时报告，前方50海里为雷达盲区。
飞：收到，下降到8900米，到达时报告。国航121
问：根据信息，以下哪项关于国航121的信息是正确的？
choices: It will descend to 8900 meters after 50 miles
It will enter into a radar blind area
It will lose radio signal soon
It will report position after 50 miles
choicesZh: 飞机将会进入雷达盲区
飞机不久将会失去无线电信号
飞机在50海里后将报告位置
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. It will enter into a radar blind area

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shanghai Control, ACA208, we caught sight of an emergency beacon on the sea.
CTL: Roger, ACA208, thanks, we will send the message to relative department.
Q: According to the exchange, which is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：上海区调，加航208，我们看到海上有紧急救援无线电信标。
管：收到，加航208，谢谢，我们会将信息发给相关部门。
问：根据对话，哪项是正确的？
choices: The center warning lights of ACA208 illuminated
ACA208 reported an emergency signal in sight
ACA208 found something on fire in the sea
choicesZh: 加航208报告紧急信号可见
加航208发现海上有物体起火
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. ACA208 reported an emergency signal in sight

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Delivery, CCA102, our aircraft is being cleaned, request 10-minute delay.
CTL: Roger, CCA102, call back when ready.
Q: According to the report, what probably was CCA102 doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京放行，国航102，飞机正在清洁，请求延迟10分钟。
管：收到，国航102，准备好后呼叫我。
问：根据报告，国航102可能正在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Cleaning the aircraft cabin

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES263, cleared to Taiyuan, flight planned route, 8400m, expect runway 18L, RENOB 12 departure, initially climb to and maintain 2100m on QNH 1013, approach frequency 129.7, squawk 3201.
Q: Which information in the delivery clearance is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方263，可以按计划航路飞往太原，8400米，使用跑道18左，按RENOB 12离场，起始上升保持修正海压2100米，修正海压1013，进近频率129.7，应答机3201。
问：以下哪项是正确的放行许可信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Runway 18L, RENOB 12 departure, contact 129.7

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA6102, vacating the runway.
CTL: CCA6102, taxi to B2 next to an A330 on number one parking spot.
Q: What did the controller instruct the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航6102，脱离跑道。
管：国航6102，滑到B2，A330旁边，1号停机坪。
问：管制员指挥飞行员怎样做？
choices: Taxi inbound to the spot one
Taxi to Gate 2 next to A330
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Taxi inbound to the spot one

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, line up and wait, traffic turning upwind.
PIL: Roger, line up and wait, CCA121.
Q: According to the statement, why must CCA121 hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，进入跑道等待，有飞机加入一边。
飞：收到，进跑道等待，国航121。
问：根据陈述，为什么国航121需要等待？
choices: An aircraft is departing from the same runway
A ground service vehicle is crossing the runway
choicesZh: 一架飞机正从同一跑道离场
一辆地面服务车正穿过跑道
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An aircraft is departing from the same runway

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CES3512, we have some problem with magneto, request hold position for check.
CTL: CES3512, roger, call me when ready for taxi.
Q: Which part of the aircraft has a problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：地面，东方3512，我们的磁发电机出现问题，请求原地等待进行检查。
管：东方3512，收到，准备滑出叫我。
问：飞机的哪个部分出现问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Magneto

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, serious fuel leakage, request return to Beijing airport.
CTL: CCA102, roger, turn right heading 200, expect runway 01.
Q: Why did CCA102 request return to Beijing airport?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航102，燃料泄漏严重，请求返回北京机场。
管：国航102，收到，右转航向200，预计跑道01。
问：为什么国航102请求返回北京机场？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Unexpected fuel loss

cards.audioText:
RAMP: CCA102, Quarantine advises that they will get on board your aircraft for a check, please don’t let the passengers off.
PIL: Roger, CCA102.
Q: Why couldn’t the passengers on CCA102 disembark yet?
cards.audioTextZh:
停机坪：国航102，检疫通知将会对飞机进行检查，请不要让乘客下飞机。
飞：收到，国航102。
问：为什么国航102的乘客仍无法下飞机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due to quarantine inspection

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA124, climb to 8400m, expedite passing 7800m, caution traffic 10 o’clock 25 kilometers, eastbound B737, 7200m maintaining.
PIL: Looking, CCA124.
Q: What direction was the traffic likely located from CCA124?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航124，上升到8400米，快速通过7800米，注意25千米10点方向往东活动的B737，7200米保持。
飞：正在观察，国航124。
问：活动可能位于国航124哪个方向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Left upward

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Ground, CES5215, startup failed, request taxi delay.
CTL: CES5215, do you require GPU assistance?
PIL: Affirm, correction, negative, APU is available now.
Q: What might the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉地面，东方5215，开车失败，请求推迟滑行。
管：东方5215，你需要GPU援助吗？
飞：是的，更正，不需要，APU现在可用。
问：飞行员可能想怎样做？
choices: Hold position to wait for GPU
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Hold position for engine check

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA981, request priority takeoff. We have first-aid relief materials on board.
CTL: CCA981, 10-minute delay due heavy snow. We’ll give you clearance as soon as possible.
Q: Why did the pilot request priority takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航981，请求优先起飞，机上有紧急救援物资。
管：国航981，由于大雪延误10分钟，我们会尽快给你通知。
问：飞行员为什么请求优先起飞？
choices: Because there were VIP on board
Because the crew needed a relief pilot
Because there were emergency supplies on board
choicesZh: 因为机组需要后备飞行员
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because there were emergency supplies on board

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA121, request taxi to runway 18L.
CTL: CCA121, clear to taxi via Z3 A3 B, hold short of runway 18L. There’s a B777 inbound for Gate 16, report when clear.
Q: What has CCA121 been instructed to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
北京地面，国航121，请求滑到跑道18左。
管：国航121，可以经Z3，A3和B滑行，在跑道18左等待。一架B777正滑向16号机位，通过后报告。
choices: Taxi to holding point on runway 18L
Hold position until another aircraft has passed
Give way to another aircraft and hold position
choicesZh: 原地等待另一架飞机通过
给另一架飞机让路并原地等待
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Hold position until another aircraft has passed

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, CCA104, request landing on runway 18L.
CTL: Negative, CCA104, Beijing Approach, runway 18L not available, we had the runway foamed for an emergency landing and it is being cleaned up now. Advise use runway 18R.
Q: Why can’t CCA104 land on runway 18L?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京进近，国航104，请求跑道18左着陆。
管：不可以，国航104，北京进近，跑道18左不可用。由于紧急着陆跑道被喷洒泡沫，现在正在清理，建议使用跑道18右。
问：为什么国航104不能在跑道18左着陆？
choices: Preceding aircraft is making an emergency landing
The runway is being foamed now
choicesZh: 前方飞机正在进行紧急着陆
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The runway is undergoing cleaning

cards.audioText:
PIL: Chengdu Control, CSN6161, request emergency descent to 8400m, suspect air convective motion between the two sides of the mountain.
CTL: Roger, CSN6161, descend to 8400m, if unable, call me again.
Q: According to the report, what was the aircraft experiencing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：成都区调，南航6161，请求紧急下降到8400米，山两侧之间疑似有空气对流运动。
管：收到，南航6161，下降到8400米，如果不能再次呼叫我。
问：根据对话，飞机正在经历什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Terrain turbulence

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, CCA121, request landing runway 36R.
CTL: CCA121, circle to land runway 36L, 36R unavailable due traffic.
Q: What should CCA121 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京进近，国航121，请求跑道36右着陆。
管：国航121，盘旋进近跑道36左，由于活动跑道36右不可用。
问：国航121接下来应该怎么做？
choices: Land as soon as possible to avoid traffic
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Land on runway 36L

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, turn right heading 090 for identification.
PIL: Turn right heading 090, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, radar contact, position 10 miles northwest of HY.
Q: What did the controller intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，右转航向090识别。
飞：右转航向090，国航102。
管：国航102，雷达收到，位置HY西北10海里。
问：管制员想要做什么？
choices: Vector the aircraft due to spacing
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Find the aircraft on radar

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Control, I cannot contact CSN6107 on 125.9, if able, pass message aircraft has been radar identified and should maintain present level.
PIL: Wilco, CCA102.
Q: According to the statement, what did the controller do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，北京区调，在125.9无法联系南航6107，如有可能，请转发信息，雷达已识别，保持当前高度。
飞：照办，国航102。
问：根据对话，管制员做了什么？
choices: Instructed CCA102 to omit position report and maintain present level
Asked CCA102 to change frequency on 125.9
choicesZh: 指挥国航102省略位置报并保持当前高度
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Asked CCA102 to transmit information

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN6645, Beijing Control, radar shows you are descending, confirm level?
PIL: Present level 10700m, CSN6645, we have been level 05 minutes, has your radar been interrupted?
Q: What did the pilot report to ATC?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航6645，北京区调，雷达显示你正在下降，证实高度？
飞：当前高度10700米，南航6645，我们已经平飞5分钟，你的雷达信号是否被中断？
问：飞行员向ATC报告了什么？
choices: Flight level of the aircraft was normal
The aircraft had descended 5 minutes ago
The aircraft can only hold for 5 minutes
choicesZh: 他们的雷达信号被中断
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flight level of the aircraft was normal

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, descend to 3000m, turn left heading 030, continue approach for Hongqiao ILS, runway 36. Report established.
PIL: Descend to 3000m, left heading 030, report established, CCA101.
Q: Which of the following should the crew do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航101，下降到3000米，左转航线030，继续虹桥36号盲降进近，截获报。
飞：下降到3000米，左转航线030，建立报，国航101。
问：以下哪项是机组应该做的？
choices: Report to ATC after localizer capture
Report after establishing on runway 36 glide slope
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Report to ATC after localizer capture

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL405 cleared to land.
PIL: Tower, UAL405, we have indications that our landing gear has not fully been extended, request low pass and tower fly-by for visual inspection.
Q: Which of the following statements is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：美联航405，可以着陆。
飞：塔台，美联航405，显示起落架似乎无法完全放下，请求低空通场和低空飞越塔台进行目视检查。
问：以下陈述哪项是正确的？
choices: UAL405 requested low pass due to traffic flying by
UAL405 requested low pass due to possible undercarriage problem
UAL405 had visual of other aircraft
choicesZh: 由于飞过活动，美联航405请求低空通场
由于起落架疑似故障，美联航405请求低空通场
美联航405可见另一架飞机
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. UAL405 requested low pass due to possible undercarriage problem

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CCA108, the aircraft is rolling right and left up to 20 degrees, something is wrong with the rudder.
CTL: CCA108, confirm you have a problem with the radar?
Q: According to the pilot, what was malfunctioning?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，国航108，飞机左右滚动20度，方向舵出现问题。
管：国航108，确认飞机雷达出现故障？
问：根据飞行员所说，哪个部分出现了故障？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Rudder

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CCA104, downwind.
CTL: CCA104, extend downwind one minute due departing aircraft, report turning base.
Q: What was the pilot instructed to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，国航104，三边。
管：国航104，由于离场飞机，将三边延长1分钟，转四边时报告。
问：飞行员收到的指令是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Extend landing time

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, confirm Shenyang Center frequency is 118.9, we cannot establish contact with them.
CTL: CCA102, we have informed Shenyang Control by phone, try again 118.9.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航102，证实沈阳中心频率118.9，我们无法建立联系。
管：国航102，已经电话通知沈阳区调，再试一次118.9。
问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: The pilot is asking for frequency conversion
The pilot is trying to make contact with Shenyang
The controller is correcting the frequency
choicesZh: 飞行员正在请求通话移交
管制员正在检查无线电
飞行员正在试图与沈阳建立通话
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The pilot is trying to make contact with Shenyang

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES5766, make a 360 turn left for sequencing.
PIL: 360 turn left, CES5766.
Q: What might be the purpose of the controller?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方5766，左转360由于排序。
飞：左转360，东方5766。
问：管制员的目的可能是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. For separation

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CES5549, going around, runway lighting failure.
CTL: CES5549, standard missed approach procedure as published.
Q: What was the cause of the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，东方5549，复飞，跑道照明故障。
管：东方5549，按标准程序复飞。
问：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Ground lighting failure

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA104, expedite taxi, traffic on final, caution shuttle bus is crossing from next intersection, report runway vacated.
PIL: Expediting, report vacated, CCA104.
Q: Why should CCA104 expedite taxiing?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航104，加速滑行，五边有活动，注意下个交叉点有摆渡车穿过，跑道脱离报告。
飞：加速，脱离后报告，国航104。
问：为什么国航104要加速滑行？
choices: Give way to traffic on the next intersection
To avoid a shuttle bus ahead
choicesZh: 给下个交叉点活动让路
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To avoid traffic on final

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, climb to and maintain 10100m finally.
PIL: Control, CCA121, request 8900m for cruising due to weight.
CTL: CCA121, due to Shenyang restriction, if above 9500m is not acceptable, you should descend to 7500m or below.
Q: According to the controller’s statement, which level was available?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，上升保持巡航高度10100米。
飞：区调，国航121，由于重量请求巡航高度8900米。
管：国航121，由于沈阳限制区，9500米以上不可行，你要下降到7500米或以下。
问：根据管制员的陈述，哪个高度是可行的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 7500 meters

cards.audioText:
PIL: Control, CCA102, 35km east of WA at 10100m, WA 45, correction 55, request clearance to cross airway R25 at YW.
CTL: CCA102, approved. Cross airway R25 at YW.
Q: According to the pilot, when would CCA102 arrive at WA?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：区调，国航102，WA东35千米，10100米。到WA 45分，更正，55分，请求在YW穿过航路R25的许可。
管：国航102，同意。在YW穿过航路R25。
问：根据飞行员，国航102何时会到达WA？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 55

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Tower, CES435, ready for takeoff.
CTL: CES435, Wuhan Tower, cleared for takeoff, runway 25, after takeoff, turn right heading 300.
Q: What should CES435 do after takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉塔台，东方435，准备好起飞。
管：东方435，武汉塔台，可以起飞，跑道25，起飞后右转航向300。
问：东方435起飞后应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Turn right, heading 300

cards.audioText:
PIL: Departure, CSN305, reaching 3000m. Request climb to 5700m.
CTL: CSN305, climb to 5400m. Expedite climb until passing 4200m, report reaching.
Q: In which level should CSN305 speed up its climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：离场，南航305，到达3000米，请求上升到5700米。
管：南航305，上升到5400米。加速上升直到通过4200米，到达时报告。
问：南航305应该在哪个高度范围内加速上升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 3000 meters to 4200 meters

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA231, there are flames coming from our No.2 engine. Request emergency service.
CTL: CCA231, roger, fire engines and ambulance will be available in a few minutes.
Q: What problem did the No.2 engine have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航231，2号发动机有火冒出，请求紧急服务。
管：国航231，收到，几分钟内消防车和救护车将准备好。
问：2号发动机出现哪种问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. No.2 engine was on fire

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA918, squawk 1630, runway 25, information S, request taxi to intersection departure A.
CTL: CCA918, taxi via D3 to holding point A, runway 25, there will be a vehicle on B giving way to you.
Q: What should CCA918 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航918，应答机1630，跑道25，通播S，请求滑行至交叉点A离场。
管：国航918，经D3滑到等待点A，跑道25，等待点B的车辆会给你让路。
问：国航918下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Taxi to the threshold of runway 25
Taxi via D3 to holding point B
Give way to a vehicle on B
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Taxi to holding point A

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CES5117, boarding is conducting, besides, catering is delayed, we will delay 15 minutes, request takeoff after 45.
CTL: Roger, CES5117, delay for 15 minutes.
Q: Why can’t CES5117 take off on time?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，东方5117，正在登机。此外，配餐延迟，我们会推后15分钟，请求45分后起飞。
管：收到，东方5117，延误15分钟。
问：为什么东方5117无法准时起飞？
choices: Cargo loading hasn’t been completed yet
Some passengers have missed the flight
The crew haven’t completed their checklists
Boarding hasn’t been completed and catering is delayed
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Boarding hasn’t been completed and catering is delayed

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, ACA165, request pushback delay due TCAS failure.
CTL: Roger ACA165, call me when ready.
Q: Why couldn’t the aircraft push back?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，加航165，由于TCAS故障请求延迟推出。
管：收到，加航165，准备好呼叫我。
问：为什么飞机无法推出？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. TCAS problem

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, backtrack to vacate via P3.
PIL: Tower, if available, request vacate via P4, CCA101.
Q: What did the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航101，掉头经P3脱离。
飞：塔台，如果可以，请求经P4脱离，国航101。
问：飞行员想要怎样做？
choices: Backtrack to vacate the runway via P3
Backtrack to vacate the runway via P4
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Vacate the runway via P4

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN6621, a helicopter is patrolling 3 miles north of the extended centerline of runway 18 below 1200m. Do not pass through the localizer.
PIL: Wilco, CSN6621.
Q: According to the controller, where was the helicopter?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航6621，一架直升机正在平行跑道18中心线延长线3海里高度低于1200米。不要穿过航向道。
飞：照办，南航6621。
问：根据管制员的话，直升机的位置在哪里？
choices: On the extended centerline at 1200 meters
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Below 1200 meters near runway 18

cards.audioText:
PIL: London Control, BAW403, we’ve lost pitch control, we need a very long final, request fire services on landing, position 14 miles from threshold, 4000 feet, heading 250.
CTL: BAW403, London, continue this heading for a moment, I’ll give you permission to make a long precision approach immediately.
Q: What did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：伦敦区调，英航403，飞机失去俯仰操纵，我们需要长五边，请求着陆后消防服务，位置在入口14海里，高度4000英尺，航向250。
管：英航403，伦敦，暂时继续该航向，我会立刻给你长五边精密进场许可。
问：飞行员请求了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A long distance final

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CSN302, no contact at minima, going around.
CTL: CSN302, standard procedure.
Q: What is the reason for going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，南航302，最低高度无法看到地面，复飞。
管：南航302，标准程序。
问：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Poor visibility

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, CCA334, confirm after departure heading south.
C: Negative, for your information, a glider is over near the south field.
Q: Why did the controller deny the pilots’ confirmation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：放行，国航334，确认离场后航向朝南。
管制员：不同意，提醒一下南部机场有一架滑翔机。
问：管制员为什么拒绝了飞行员的确认请求？
choices: The controller wants the pilot to fly east.
Flying activity is in the south field.
A glider will land in the south field.
A glider is hanging in the north field.
choicesZh: 管制员希望飞行员向东飞。
一架滑翔机将在南部机场降落。
一架滑翔机在机场北部滑翔。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flying activity is in the south field.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Ground, CCA101, request tow Boeing 737 from stand M5 to maintenance apron due to the nose gear jammed.
C: The tow approved via taxiway M to maintenance apron.
Q: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉地面，国航101，由于前起落架卡阻，申请拖车将波音737从停机位M5拖至维修机坪。
管制员：拖车可以经由滑行道M到维修机坪。
问：飞机的问题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Nose gear can't be moved.

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW204, taxi to the holding point runway 27 via taxi way F, J and G.
PIL: F, J and G, to holding point runway 27, BAW204.
Q: What are the taxi routes?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：英航204，经滑行道F，J和G滑到跑道27等待点。
飞：F，J和G，跑道27等待点，英航204。
问：滑行路线是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. F, J and G

cards.audioText:
PIL: UAL303, we'll have to go back to the maintenance apron to check our flight controls. We found the rudder pedals are a bit tight.
CTL: UAL303, roger, taxi to stand 12. We'll contact maintenance department.
Q: What is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：美联航303，我们必须返回维修停机坪检查飞机的飞行控制。我们发现方向舵踏板有一些紧。
管：美联航303，收到，滑到机位12。我们会联系维修部门。
问：飞机遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The rudder pedals are jammed

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW141 continue on the inner taxiway, at M join the outer taxiway, cross 31L at K.
PIL: OK by the inner taxiway and uh.., M outer taxiway and uh…, K A, cross 31L uh…BAW141.
Q: What is the controller's taxi instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：英航141，继续在内滑行道滑行，在M加入外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左。
飞：好吧，内滑行道滑行，然后……M外滑行道，然后……K，A穿越跑道31左……英航141。
问：管制员的滑行指令是什么？
choices: K to inner, outer, cross 31L at M
Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K
M to outer, inner, cross 31L at K.
M to inner, outer, cross 31L at K
choicesZh: K加入内滑行道、外滑行道，在M穿越跑道31左
内滑行道滑行，M加入外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左
M加入外滑行道、内滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左
M加入内滑行道、外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES5401, maintain 8400m to HG unless otherwise instructed.
PIL: CES5401, maintain 8400m to HG.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方5401，保持8400米，直飞HG，除非另有指示。
飞：东方5401，保持8400米，直飞HG。
问：管制员的指令是什么意思？
choices: There is no possibility for level change
There is much possibility for level change
There is a little possibility for level change
choicesZh: 很有可能有改变飞行高度
很小可能改变飞行高度
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is a little possibility for level change

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN5265, pull in to the left, there is a B747 overtaking you on the right.
PIL: Roger, traffic in sight, CSN5265.
Q: What will the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航5265，牵入左侧，你右侧有一架B747。
飞：收到，能看到飞机，南航5265。
问：飞行员要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Give way to the B747

cards.audioText:
A: Do you know there’s a word that the controllers use to inform the pilots to ignore the clearance, issues at the beginning of the transmission?
B: Yes, there is an ICAO standard word.
Q: What word are they talking about in this conversation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：你知道管制员常使用的一个单词，这个单词用来告诉飞行员忽略掉开始发话中的滑行许可吗？
B：知道，是有这个ICAO标准词汇。
问：在这段对话中，他们讨论的是哪个词？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Disregard

cards.audioText:
A: On landing, I noticed the nose gear has a little shimmy.
B: Ok, I'll check it, the fork looks good and the strut is in the center but the gear has not been locked down properly.
Q: What was the problem with the nose gear on landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：着陆的时候，我注意到前起落架有点振动。
B：好，我去检查下，连杆看起来没问题，支柱也处于中心位置，但是起落架没有被正确锁定。
问：着陆时，前起落架出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. A little shaking.

cards.audioText:
A: There is a height which the pilot must have the runway approach lights in sight, to continue the descent, or if not, must initiate the go-around during the precision approach.
B: The height is very important for safety.
Q: What were the men talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：在精密进近中，存在一个高度，在这个高度上，飞行员必须看到跑道进场灯来继续下降，如果没有看到，就必须执行复飞。
B：这个高度对飞行安全非常重要。
问：两人在讨论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Decision height.

cards.audioText:
CTL: ACA233, descend and maintain FL230.
PIL: Control, can we have that at the pilot's discretion?
Q: What was the pilot's intention under this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：加航233，下高度层230保持。
飞行员：区调，我们可以自行决定吗？
问：在此情况下，飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: To continue descent by ATC instruction.
To decide how to fly by himself.
To decide when to descend by himself.
choicesZh: 通过管制指令继续下降。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To decide when to descend by himself.

cards.audioText:
CTL: NWA291, expedite descent to and maintain 3000 feet on QNH1012, join right downwind for runway 21L.
Q: Which level should the aircraft descend to and maintain?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：西北291，加速下降到3000英尺保持，修正海压1012，加入右三边，跑道21左。
问：航空器需要下降并保持在哪个高度层？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 3,000 feet on QNH1012

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES402, turn right heading 040, descend to 900m, QFE1002.
Q: Which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
东方402，右转航向040，下降到900米，场面气压1002。
问：以下哪个是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Descend to 900m.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, severe turbulence was reported at FL290 over MRT.
PIL: Roger, request to alter the route because we have some problem with the yaw damper.
Q: What does the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航101，MRT上方高度层290处有严重颠簸报告。
飞行员：收到，请求改变航路，因为我们的偏航阻尼出故障。
问：飞行员想干什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To use alternate route

cards.audioText:
CTL: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Control, this is UAL982, my elevator is jammed in the up position and I cannot control my attitude, nor can I close my throttle.
PIL: UAL982, roger mayday. What is your intention?
Q: Which are involved in the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，武汉区调，美联航982，升降舵卡在上位，无法控制姿态，也不能关闭油门。
管制员：美联航982，收到Mayday，你的意图是什么？
问：问题包含哪些？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Throttle, elevator, attitude.

cards.audioText:
CTL: AFR334, negative to start up. We had an emergency this morning. There is still foam on the runway and it is being cleaned up at the moment.
PIL: Will it be reopened shortly?
CTL: Perhaps in 15 minutes, I will call you back.
Q: Why can't the pilot start up?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：法航334，不同意开车，早上出现了紧急情况，跑道上仍有泡沫，目前正在清理。
飞行员：一会儿会重新开放吗？
管制员：或许在15分钟以后，我会叫你。
问：飞行员为什么不能开车？
choicesZh: 紧急情况目前没处理完。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The runway is being cleaned.

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW141, what is your intention?
PIL: We would like to execute fuel jettison procedure before the approach. BAW141.
CTL: BAW141, turn right heading 350 to HID, hold as published.
Q: What does the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航141，你的意图是什么？
飞行员：我们想在进近前执行放油程序，英航141。
管制员：英航141，右转航向350到HID，按发布的程序等待。
问：飞行员打算做什么？
choices: To go directly to the holding point.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To dump fuel before approach.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES583, maintain flight level 330 to HG unless otherwise instructed.
PIL: Wilco, CES583.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：东方583，除非另有指令，保持高度层330到HG。
飞行员：照办，东方583。
问：管制员什么意思？
choices: There is a possibility of level change
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. There is a possibility of level change

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, you are approaching the boundary. Cross the boundary at own discretion.
PIL: Roger. CCA101.
CTL: CCA101, your ATC clearance will be suspended when you cross the boundary. Report when leaving.
Q: What can you learn from the controller's instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航101，你将穿越边界，自己掌握穿越。
飞行员：收到，国航101。
管制员：国航101，在你穿越边界时候，将暂缓发布管制许可，离开后报。
问：从管制员的指令中，你能得到什么？
choices: The controller's clearance is not available.
The flight may cross the boundary.
The flight crossed the boundary and made an approach
choicesZh: 飞机穿越边界并进行进近。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The flight may cross the boundary.

cards.audioText:
PIL: AFR188, we'd like to delay our start-up. Flight operations have just told us we are to pick up 30 passengers from a Lufthansa flight which has been cancelled. I will call you back when we are ready.
CTL: AFR188, departure time 25, start up at own discretion.
Q: Why does the crew want to delay startup?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：法航188，我们希望推迟开车，运营部门告知我们，需要接载30名乘客，他们来自汉莎航空取消了的航班。我们准备好后再呼叫你。
管制员：法航188，起飞时间25分，自行决定开车。
问：机组为什么想推迟开车时间？
choices: The flight has just been cancelled.
They have to wait for a Lufthansa flight.
To take passengers from another flight.
choicesZh: 他们需要等待汉莎航班。
为了接载另外一架飞机上的乘客。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To take passengers from another flight.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, UAL982, stopping at C5 intersection. I have a malfunction with my nose gear steering. Request assistance.
C: United airline 982, roger. I will send a tug right away.
Q: What is the pilot's problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，美联航982，在C5交叉点停下，前轮转弯故障，请求支援。
管制员：美联航982，收到，马上派拖车。
问：飞行员的问题是什么？
choices: He needs a tug to push-back.
He needs a tug to get him back.
His nose gear is bogged down.
His nose gear is broken down.
choicesZh: 他的前起落架陷入泥地。
他的前起落架出故障了。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. His nose gear is broken down.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR188, for identification, turn left heading 270 and then turn right heading 360.
P: Left turn 270 and right for 360, AFR188.
Q: Why was AFR188 instructed to make this maneuver?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：法航188，为了识别，左转航向270，然后右转航向360.
飞行员：左转270，然后右转360。法航188。
问：法航188为什么要做此机动？
choices: The controller tries to find the aircraft on radar.
The controller tries to find the plane's identification number.
choicesZh: 管制员试图在雷达上识别飞机。
管制员试图发现航空器识别号。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The controller tries to find the aircraft on radar.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, NWA808, 15km from YIH, we have weather ahead. Request deviation to the right.
C: Negative, turn left heading 270, resume own navigation when clear of weather.
Q: Why did NWA808 ask for circumnavigation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：区调，西北808，距YIH15公里，前方有天气，请求右偏航。
管制员：不可以，左转航向270，绕开天气后恢复自主领航。
问：西北808为什么请求绕航？
choices: Got a warning of wind shear.
Controller refused his request to turn left.
choicesZh: 管制员拒绝了他左转的请求。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Encountered an adverse meteorological condition.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CES5321, 12,000m, 4 minutes to boundary.
C: CES5321, maintaining altitude and heading, contact 125.6, good day.
Q: What is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉区调，东方5321，高度12000米，4分钟到达边界。
管制员：东方5321，保持高度和航向，联系125.6，再见。
问：正在发生什么？
choices: The flight was going to be handed over to next controller.
The pilot had established communication with Wuhan.
The controller was telling the pilot his frequency.
The pilot was listening to ATIS.
choicesZh: 飞机将要移交给下一个管制。
飞行员与武汉区调已经建立联系。
管制员正告知飞行员他的频率。
飞行员正在守听自动终端情报服务。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The flight was going to be handed over to next controller.

cards.audioText:
C: United 755, ceiling 250 feet variable. Visibility 2200 meters in fog, advise go around.
P: United 755.
P: United 755 no contact at minima, overshooting.
Q: What is the reason for advised going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：美联航755，云高250英尺，风向不定，雾中能见度2200米，建议复飞。
飞行员：美联航755。
飞行员：美联航755，最低不见跑道，正在复飞。
问：建议复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Ceiling.

cards.audioText:
A: Could you check with Shanghai center to see if a high altitude is available, we need to get out of this turbulence.
B: Ok, I’ll contact with controller to see if we can get FL350.
Q: Why does the flight crew want to change altitude?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：你能和上海区调证实我们是否可以上高度，我们需要飞离颠簸。
B：好，我将和管制联系，看是否可以上高度层350。
问：为什么飞行机组想要改变高度层？
choices: To start to descend to Shanghai.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To avoid turbulent air.

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 204, taxi to the holding point RW27 via taxiway F, J and G.
P: F, J and G to holding point of RW27, Speedbird 204,
Q: What are the taxi routes?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航204，通过滑行道F，J和G滑行至跑道27等待点。
飞行员：F，J和G到跑道27等待点，英航204。
问：滑行路线是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. F, J and G.

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou Departure, CSN6549, airborne 600m, climbing 3000m, request heading 290 due weather.
Q: What stage of the flight does the transmission refer to?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：广州离场，南方6549，离地了，600米，正爬升至3000米，由于天气，请求航向290。
问：这段交流对应的飞行阶段是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After takeoff.

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR486, reaching 3000ft.
C: AFR486, climb to 9000ft, expedite climb until passing 5000ft, report 7000ft.
Q: In which section of altitude should AFR486 speed up and climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：离场，法航486，到达3000英尺。
管制员：法航486，爬升至9000英尺，加速爬升直到过5000英尺，7000英尺报。
问：在哪个高度阶段法航486需要加速爬升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 3000 to 5000 feet.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, AFR132, 25km south of Wuhan, northbound, 2100m.
C: AFR132, say intentions.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，法航132，武汉南部25公里，向北飞，高度2100米。
管制员：法航132，说出你的意图。
问：管制员的意思是什么？
choices: To know what the pilot wants to do next.
To ask the pilot his rating.
To verify the pilot's original airport.
choicesZh: 想知道飞行员接下来打算做什么。
询问飞行员的型別等级。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To know what the pilot wants to do next.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA151, severe turbulence was reported at the FL290 over DAH.
P: Roger, request alter the route because we have some problem with the yaw damper.
Q: What does the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航151，在DAH上空高度层290上有强烈颠簸报告。
飞行员：收到，我们的偏航阻尼有问题，请求改变航路。
问：飞行员想要干什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To use alternate route

cards.audioText:
A: Do you know there’s a word that the controllers use to inform the pilot to ignore a taxi clearance, issued at the beginning of the transmission?
B: Yes, there is an ICAO standard word.
Q: What word should be used in this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：你知道管制员常使用的一个单词，这个单词用来告诉飞行员忽略掉开始发话中的滑行许可吗？
B：知道，是有这个ICAO标准词汇。
问：在这种情境下，应该使用的是哪个词？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Disregard.

cards.audioText:
C: CES345, your departure time is 1400. Is that correct?
P: Affirmative, that is our plan departure. I will call you 15 minutes before start-up.
Q: When will the pilot contact ATC?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：东方345，你的起飞时间是1400，是否正确？
飞行员：是的，这是我们的计划起飞时间。我将在开车前15分呼叫你。
问：飞行员什么时候联系管制员？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Fifteen minutes before start-up.

cards.audioText:
C: United 223 RVR runway 36L, touch down 600m, midpoint 850m, stop end missing.
P: United 223.
Q: What is the best RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：美联航223，跑道36左视程距：接地点：600米，中间段850米，停止端无数据丢失。
飞行员：美联航223。
问：最佳跑道视程距是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. midpoint.

cards.audioText:
A: Hey, look that, there is some rubber on the runway. Maybe it came from an aircraft tyre.
B: Have we had any reports from landing or departing aircraft?
Q: What was on the runway?
cards.audioTextZh:
A: 喂，看，跑道上有些橡胶，可能来自于飞机的轮胎。
B：我们收到任何着陆或起飞的飞机报告吗？
问：跑道上有什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Rubber.

cards.audioText:
P: Ladies and gentlemen, due to our early arrival. Our gate is still occupied. We will have to wait here for a few minutes until the other plane pushes back.
Q: When can they go to their gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：女士们，先生们，因为我们提前到达，我们的停机位仍被占用。我们需要等一会，直到达其他飞机推出。
问：他们什么时候可以去停机位？
choices: Before the other plane pushes back.
Until the other plane pushes back.
choicesZh: 他们的停机位仍被占用。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Until the other plane pushes back.

cards.audioText:
C: ACA130, taxi straight ahead. The airbus 320 coming from your right will give way to you at the intersection.
Q: Which aircraft will give way to ACA130?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：加航130，直接推出，在交叉口，从右方滑行过来的空客320会给你让路。
问：哪架飞机会给加航130让路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A320 on the right.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA4106, expedite climb to 9,800m, report HZ.
P: Unable to accept 9,800m due weight. CCA4106.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航4106，加速爬升至9800米，过HZ报。
飞行员：由于重量， 9800米不可以，国航4106。.
问：管制员的意思是什么？
choices: Complaining about the weight of the flight.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Issuing a further climb instruction.

cards.audioText:
P: Delta 303, we’ll have to go back to the maintenance apron to check our flight controls. We found the rudder pedals are a bit tight.
C: Delta 303, roger, taxi to stand 12. We’ll contact maintenance department.
Q: What is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：达美303，我们必须回到维修机坪检查飞机操纵面，我们发现方向舵脚蹬有点紧。
管制员：达美303，收到，滑行到12号停机位，我们将联系维修部门。
问：问题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The rudder pedals are jammed.

cards.audioText:
P: Hong Kong Approach, China Southern 305, what are the delays like? We’ve been holding for over 50 minutes.
C: 305, expect another 10 minutes delay due ground accident.
Q: What is the total waiting time for the crew?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：香港进近，南方305，延误情况如何，我们已经等了50多分钟了。
管制员：305，由于地面事故，预计还需要再等10分钟。
问：机组一共等了多久？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 60 minutes.

cards.audioText:
C: Air china 981, stop immediately, I say again, stop now. Flames coming from right main gear.
P: Stopping, 981.
C: 981, fire engines and ambulance will be available in a few minutes.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航981，立即停下，我再说一遍，立即停下，右边主起落架起火。
飞行员；正在停下，981。
管制员：981，消防车和救护车一会就到场。
问：发生了什么事？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Undercarriage fire.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA4106, line up after the landing airbus. Call me when ready for departure.
P: Traffic in sight, CCA4106.
Q: What should the pilot do right now?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航4106，在着陆的空客飞机之后上跑道，准备好起飞时呼叫我。
飞行员：看见航空器了，国航4106.
问：飞行员现在应该马上干什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Hold his position.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL982, climb 7,200m on standard and maintain, report passing 6,600m.
P: Roger, climb to 7,200m and call passing 6,600m, UAL982.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：美联航982，按标准程序爬升并保持7200米，过6600米报。
飞行员：收到，爬升至7200米，过6600米报，美联航982。
问：管制员是什么意思？
choices: Climb and hold on standard pattern.
choicesZh: 按标准航路爬升和等待。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Climb on QNE.

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, NWA205, maintaining 4,800 meters.
C: NWA205, roger, squawk 4207, reduce speed 250 knots, and report DSG.
Q: What information are included in controller’s instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：进近，西北205，保持4800米。
管制员：西北205，收到，应答机4207，速度减小至250节，过DSG报。
问：管制员的指令中包含了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 4207, 250, DSG.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CSN3342, HM at 35, 9,600m, estimating XSH at 50, next HG.
C: CSN3342, Wuhan Control, can you lose 5 minutes en route due to traffic separation?
Q: What does the controller want the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉区调，南方3342，HM35分，高度9600米，预计XSH50分，下一个HG。
管制员：南方3342，武汉区调，由于间隔，你能否在航路上消耗5分钟吗？
问：管制员希望飞行员做什么？
choices: To keep enough space from the traffic ahead.
To hold at present position for 5 minutes.
choicesZh: 与前方飞机保持足够间隔。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To keep enough space from the traffic ahead.

cards.audioText:
A: John, do you know there’s a word that ATC would use to inform the pilots the changes be made of last clearance and this new clearance substitute the previous clearance.
B: Ah, yes, it is. Yes.
Q: What word should be used in this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：约翰，你知道吗，管制员会用一个词来通知飞行员最近一次许可的变更，新的许可将取代以前的许可？
B：嗯，是的，是的。
问：在这种情况下应该用哪个词？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Reclear.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Tower, China southern 302 no contact at minima, going around
C: China southern 302, standard procedure.
Q: What is the reason for going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：北京塔台，南方302，最低不见跑道，正在复飞。
管制员：南方302，标准程序。
问：复飞的原因是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. poor visibility.

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, Air France 456, we are coming back due to a cracked wind screen caused by a bird strike during departure.
C: Air France 456, roger, join right hand downwind.
Q: Why did Air France return?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：离场，法航456，由于离场时飞机遭遇鸟击，导致风挡玻璃出现裂纹，我们正在返回机场。
管制员：法航456，收到，加入右三边。
问：法航为什么返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Windscreen broken.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Delivery, CES113, bay 213, information X, bound for Zhengzhou, request ATC clearance.
CTL: CES113, say again your bay number.
Q: Where is the aircraft parking?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉放行，东方113，213号机位，通播X，飞往郑州，请求管制许可。
管制员：东方113，再说一遍你的停机位。
问：飞机现在停在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Stand 213

cards.audioText:
PIL: CCA1508, RVR runway 06 touch-down 650m, mid-point 750m, stop end 700m.
Q: What is the worst RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航1508，跑道06视距：接地点650米，中间段750米，停止端700米。
问：最差的视距值是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Touch-down

cards.audioText:
CIL: BAW101, Lanzhou Control, traffic 10 o’clock, 8km, eastbound, Boeing 757, 1800m, descending.
Q: Which of the following information about the traffic is not correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航101，兰州区调，航空器10点钟，8公里，向东飞，波音757，高度1800米，正下降。
问：关于这架航空器，以下哪个信息是不正确的？
choices: The traffic is on the left side.
The traffic is flying to the east.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The traffic is ascending.

cards.audioText:
CTL: All stations, emergency descent between WF and VM, all aircraft below 3900m between WF and VM leave corridor to the east immediately.
Q: Which of the following aircraft should need to leave the corridor?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：各台注意，在WF和VM之间有紧急下降的航空器，所有WF和VM之间低于3900米的航空器立即离开走廊，向东飞。
问：以下哪个航空器需要离开走廊？
choices: Aircraft at 4500m between WF and VM.
Aircraft at 3600m between WF and VM.
Aircraft at 2700m outside WF and VM.
choicesZh: WF和VM之间高度4500米的航空器
WF和VM之间高度3600米的航空器
WF和VM之外高度2700米的航空器
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Aircraft at 3600m between WF and VM.

cards.audioText:
PIL: JAL697, the weather is below VFR minima due to a fog bank obscuring the south end of the field, we would like to delay our approach for 30 minutes.
Q: What is the reason for the delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：日航697，由于一团雾遮蔽了机场南端，天气低于VFR最低值，我们想延误30分钟进近。
问：延误的原因是什么？
choices: The aircraft can only perform VFR flight
choicesZh: 飞机只能进行目视飞行
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Low visibility

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, EVA988, boarding is not completed yet, besides we have a catering delay, we’ll be ready in 15 minutes, could you put me on request for a slot time after 45?
Q: What is not the reason for the delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：北京塔台，长荣988，登机目前尚未完成，此外，我们有配餐延误，我们将延误15分钟，你能给我们一个45分的离场时间吗？
问：什么不是延误的原因？
choices: The slot time is not correct.
They haven’t received the requirement from ATC.
choicesZh: 他们还没有收到管制的要求
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The slot time is not correct.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shanghai ground, CCA1308, would you conform that there is a security van waiting for us? We are carrying a valuable shipment, and the company won’t answer us on company frequency.
Q: Why does the pilot ask for a security van?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：上海地面，国航1308，你能证实下有没有安保车等我们吗？我们运送的是贵重的货物，公司没有用公司的频率回答我们。
问：飞行员为什么请求安保车？
choices: There is precious goods on board.
They switched to the wrong company frequency.
choicesZh: 他们转换到了错误的公司频率
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is precious goods on board.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shenyang Control, CES5107, we’re in manual control now, we don’t have the steering problem anymore. There must be something wrong with the boosted control.
Q: What problem does the pilot have now?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：沈阳区调，东方5107，我们现在正在手动操纵，我们已经不再有转向问题，助力操纵肯定是出问题了。
问：飞行员现在遇到的问题是什么？
choices: Their auto pilot can not work.
choicesZh: 他们遇到了助力系统失效
他们的自动驾驶不工作
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They meet boosted control failure.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guangzhou Approach, CCA591, we don’t want to chance an instrument approach, in case we lost power to the instruments, request the BTO latest weather?
Q: What is the possible intention of the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：广州进近，国航591，我们不想尝试仪表进近，以防仪表断电，请求BTO最新天气？
问：飞行员可能的意图是什么？
choices: They face an instrument power failure.
They want to over fly BTO because of bad weather.
choicesZh: 由于恶劣天气，他们想飞越BTO
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They may divert to BTO.

cards.audioText:
A: Standby one, I'll check the flight plan.
B: Standby, sir.
A: There must be something wrong with your flight plan, the departure time had been wrongly entered into local time instead of UTC.
Q: What's the mistake of the flight plan?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：稍等，我将检查飞行计划。
B：稍等。
A：你的飞行计划肯定有问题，你的离场时间错误地输入了当地时间，而不是世界协调时。
问：飞行计划有什么问题？
choices: The arrival time had been entered in UTC instead of local time.
The arrival time had been entered in local time instead of UTC.
The departure time had been entered in UTC instead of local time.
The departure time had been entered in local time instead of UTC.
choicesZh: 进港时间输入的是世界协调时，而不是当地时间。
进场时间输入的是当地时间，而不是世界协调时
离场时间输入的是世界协调时间而不是当地时间
离场时间输入的是当地时间而不是世界协调时
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The departure time had been entered in local time instead of UTC.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CSN3602, ILS approach, short final. We are at low electrical power and we will shut off the landing lights and taxiing lights and manually extend the landing gear due electrical unloading.
Q: What kind of problem does the aircraft encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：北京塔台，南方3602，盲降进近，短五边。我们电量低，我们将关断着陆灯光以及滑行灯，由于电量负载，将手动放下起落架。
问：飞机遇到了什么样的问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Electrical power shortage.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Xi’an Control, UAL457, fuel flow indicator of No.3 engine out of operation, but we found No.3 engine working normally.
Q: What’s wrong with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：西安区调，美联航457,3号发动机的油量指示失效，但是我们发现3号发动机工作正常。
问：飞机出什么问题了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Engine No.3 fuel indicator failure.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shanghai Control, ACA204, it looks like our windshield is iced cover. Does the Met confirm severe icing in this area?
Q: What is the intention of the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：上海区调，加航204，看起来我们风挡玻璃被冰覆盖，气象报证实此区域有重度积冰吗？
问：飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: He wants to confirm the weather condition.
He is sure that he encounters icing condition.
choicesZh: 他确定自己遇到了积冰情况
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. He wants to confirm the weather condition.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Chengdu Approach, QFA508, outer windshield panel appears to be crazed by hailstones or lightning, because we heard a thump.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：成都进近，澳航508，外挡风玻璃似乎被冰雹或闪电打坏了，因为我们听到了砰的一声。
问：发生了什么？
choices: The aircraft meets with bird strike.
The aircraft suffers from lightning strike.
The aircraft’s outside windshield is cracked.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The aircraft’s outside windshield is cracked.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Sanya Tower, HNA512, hailstones have ripped off the nose cone, caused a big hole in port engine cowling and cracked the windshield.
Q: According to the sentence, what may the aircraft encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：三亚塔台，海南512，冰雹撕裂了机鼻，在左发动机整流罩上造成了一个大洞，风挡玻璃也破裂了。
问：根据这句话，飞机可能遇到了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Structural damage

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guiyang Tower, CCA1502, request oxygen supply on landing for about 10 passengers, because several oxygen masks didn’t drop out at decompression.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：贵阳塔台，国航1502，着陆后请求给10名乘客提供氧气，因为在失压时，几个氧气面罩没有脱落。
问：发生了什么？
choices: The oxygen masks drops automatically due decompression.
Some oxygen masks did not drop during decompression.
Several oxygen masks are missing during decompression.
choicesZh: 由于失压，氧气面罩自动脱落
在失压时一些氧气面罩没有脱落
在失压时，有些氧气面罩不见了
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Some oxygen masks did not drop during decompression.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Lanzhou Tower, CSN517, we have undercarriage trouble, we would like to overshoot.
Q: What is the pilot going to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：兰州塔台，南方517，起落架故障，我们想要复飞。
问：飞行员打算将要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Make a missed approach.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Xiamen Tower, UAL169, we have a full emergency now. We’re unable to lower the nose wheel, we’d like to make low pass so that you can check whether nose wheel is down.
Q: What kind of problem does the pilot have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：厦门塔台，美联航169，我们现在有全面的紧急情况，我们无法放下前轮，我们想做低空通场，这样你可以检查一下前轮是否放下。
问：飞行员遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Undercarriage problem

cards.audioText:
CTL: JAL220, set heading to MN, after passing MN heading 270 to start jettison, upon completion turn right direct to BX, descend to 5100m.
Q: When shall the aircraft turn right and fly to BX?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：日航220，直飞MN，过MN后航向270开始放油，完成后，右转直飞BX，下5100米。
问：飞机应该什么时候右转直飞BX？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After finishing the fuel dumping

cards.audioText:
PIL: CCA1503, JAL907, please establish communication with Bravo Control on 123.75, tell him we are having trouble with the transceiver.
Q: What does the pilot request JAL 907 do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：国航1503，日航907，请与B区调123.75建立通讯，告诉他我们收发机故障。
问：飞行员请求日航907做什么？
choices: Relay his information to the controller.
choicesZh: 将他的信息转发给管制员
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Relay his information to the controller.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES2508, Beijing Approach, ident observed, will continue to pass instructions.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：东方2508，北京进近，已看到，将继续发布指令。
问：管制员的意思是什么？
choices: The aircraft is observed on the radar scope.
The aircraft will be switched to procedure control.
The communication is cut in and out.
choicesZh: 飞机遇到了无线电失效
飞机已经在雷达上看到
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The aircraft is observed on the radar scope.

cards.audioText:
CTL: All stations, Beijing Approach, HAL109, B747, heavy, lost communication at 37, last report at HOK, 5400m, descending.
Q: What may the aircraft experience?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：各台注意，北京进近，海南109，波音747，重型，在37分失去通讯，最后一次报告在HOK，高度5400米，正下降。
问：飞机可能遇到了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Lose radio communication.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Nanjing Approach, CSN3107, intercepted urgency call from CCA1504, I say again, CCA1504, request priority landing, the aircraft’s position north of YTR at 4000m.
Q: What can we conclude from the transmission?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：南京进近，南方3107，截获了来自国航1504的紧急呼叫，我再说一遍，国航1504，请求优先着陆，飞机目前在YTR北部，高度4000米。
问：我们可以从通话中得到什么？
choices: CSN3107 is in an emergency situation.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. CSN3107 is relaying information.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Urumqi Approach, CCA123, we collided with a giant vulture head on, it came through the right wind-screen, the co-pilot was fatally wounded.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：乌鲁木齐进近，国航123，我们迎头撞上了一只巨大的秃鹫，它穿过了右侧风挡玻璃，副驾受了致命伤。
问：发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Bird strike

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA182, we have just skidded off taxiway D, left main gear appears to be stuck in the mud, can you send a tug around?
Q: What happened according to the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：北京地面，国航182，我们刚刚偏出滑行道D，左起落架好像陷进泥里了，你能派一辆拖车来吗？
问：根据飞行员的话，发生了什么？
choices: The aircraft veered off the runway.
The aircraft ‘s left main gear collapses.
The aircraft collided with a car on taxiway D.
choicesZh: 飞机在滑行道D与一辆车相撞
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The aircraft is bogged down.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shantou Ground, CES517, we are stuck halfway along taxiway B2 due to unserviceable brakes and steering, request a tug to tow us back to the apron.
Q: What is the abnormal situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：汕头地面，东方517，由于刹车和转向失灵，我们卡在B2滑行道半路上，请求拖车把我们拖回停机坪。
问：紧急情况是什么？
choices: The aircraft collided with another aircraft.
The aircraft suffers from bird strike.
choicesZh: 飞机与另一架飞机相撞
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. There is a mechanical failure.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guilin Ground, CCA1538, the tow bar was broken during push-back, we are waiting for a replacement.
Q: What are the crew doing now?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：桂林地面，国航1538，推出时拖杆断裂，我们正在等待更换。
问：机组在干嘛？
choices: Waiting to replace the tow bar.
Waiting for the repair of the tow bar.
Waiting for a replacement of the aircraft.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Waiting to replace the tow bar.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, flight operations have just told us we are to pick up 30 passengers from Lufthansa flight that’s been canceled, I’ll call you back for start-up.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：北京塔台，国航1301，飞行运行刚刚告知我们，需要接上30名汉莎航班取消的乘客，开车的时候我将通知你。
问：发生了什么？
choices: 30 passengers did not board the flight on time.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 30 passengers will take CCA1301 flight.

cards.audioText:
CTL: NWA566, ILS category I minimums in effect, ILS category II is unavailable due to inoperative center-line lighting.
Q: What can we know from the sentence?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：西北566，I类盲降最低标准生效，II类盲降由于中心线灯光不工作而不可用。
问：我们可以从这句话中知道什么？
choices: Both CAT I and II are operative.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. CAT I is effective

cards.audioText:
CTL: JAL505, Beijing Tower, weather is below VFR minimums, it’s illegal for you to land, or I’ll have to write up an incident report and it might end up with a license suspension.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：日航505，北京塔台，气象低于目视飞行规则最低值，着陆是不合法的，否则我就得写一份事故报告，可能导致你被吊销执照。
问：管制员是什么意思？
choices: The aircraft is not qualified to land.
Landing in this situation is against regulations.
choicesZh: 机组不具备着陆的资质
在此情形下着陆不符合规章
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Landing in this situation is against regulations.

cards.audioText:
Captain: Have you check the loading sheet?
First officer: Yes, I just found there was a mistake on fuel quantity.
Captain: you should fix it before you give it back.
Question: What does the Captain advise the First Officer to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长：你检查过舱单了吗?
副驾：是的，我刚发现燃油量有误。
机长：你应该在交还之前把它修正。
问：机长建议副驾驶做什么？
choices: Give it back to the ground personnel.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Solve the load sheet problem.

cards.audioText:

M2: Yes, the proper use of carbon brakes will ...
Question: What is the main idea of the conversation?
cards.audioTextZh:
M1：碳刹车的磨损与使用次数和施压次数有关。
M2：是的，正确使用碳刹车会……
问：对话的主要观点是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. More brakes, more wear.
